# thousandeyes_tests_ftp_server (Resource)

Get FTP Server test.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thousandeyes_tests_ftp_server" "example" {
  interval     = 3600
  password     = "guest"
  request_type = "download"
  url          = "ftp://speedtest.tele2.net"
  username     = "anonymous"
  agents       = [{ agent_id = "3" }]
}
```
